purpose: Binds an ACP / Visa TAP / ISO 20022 checkout to a TIP-20 settlement. Maps the 32-byte Tempo memo → ISO 20022 remittance_information, sender/receiver → debtor/creditor (with optional LEI), and normalises an on-chain Tempo tx into the AP2 artifact envelope. The canonical OCG v0.3 pacs.008-subset tool for Tempo: instructs the bilateral settlement receipt that agents and merchants both verify via execution_hash. W-D terminal node.
